translations.web: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
translations.bsb: You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
translations.kjv: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
translations.asv: O God thou hast cast us off, thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; oh restore us again.
